body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Bee-Ryong Electronics presented ''Hulover BRH-H Series'', a personal compact air purifier during KES 2006. It offers intelligent automatic control by detecting the levels of containments. With Carbon filter and anion generator, it eliminates various kinds of air pollutants, VOCs and embarrassing odor.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
